meta.name: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
meta.description: In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?

videos.title: Destruction
videos.overview: After Desir and his party defeat Boromir Napolitan to escape from the Shadow World, he finds himself sent back in time to the enrollment ceremony of his school 13 years ago.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Desir takes the test to enroll in Hebrion Academy, along with Romantica and Azest in Group D.

videos.title: Comrades
videos.overview: Desir is placed in the beta class despite his test result, and so does Romantica, even though she's a noble. Desir finds Pram, another new student from the beta class, and invites Romantica to join his party.

videos.title: Forming a Party
videos.overview: With Pram and Romantica, Desir aims to win the ranking tournament to get promoted to the alpha class. Desir starts training his team to draw out their full potential, based on what he remembers.

videos.title: Rapier
videos.overview: Desir and Pram attempt to get Pram's rapier back from the man he sold it to, and uncover hidden secrets in the process.

videos.title: Final Round
videos.overview: Desir, Romantica, and Pram shine in the ranking match qualifiers, gaining fame as Beta Class stars. Their success sparks tension at Hebrion Academy, where prestigious students plot to challenge them.

videos.title: Magical Beasts
videos.overview: Desir and his team plan to survive long enough to place within the top nine, as they defend against the attacks from other parties. Then a monster has spawned, and Pram courageously stands up against it.

videos.title: Crash
videos.overview: Desir and his team find themselves in the world of the Privius Clock Tower. They make it through the survival quest and come face to face with Blue Moon, Red Dragon, and Pine Tree parties.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: Desir and his team have finally faced the Blue Moon party for the chance to become single rankers. Azest puts a stop to Desir's plan of pitting the alpha parties on each other, but Desir has another plan. And he asks Azest if she is having fun.

videos.title: Respite
videos.overview: After successfully defeating the challenge of becoming single rankers, Desir, Romantica, and Pram make the most of time to unwind before they join the alpha class.

videos.title: A Raid
videos.overview: Desir, knowing that Tear of Regernel will be stolen by the Outers, takes the initiative to stop them. As expected, Kraiken and the others show up at the Magical Tower. Can Desir protect the magical gem?

videos.title: Anti-Mage
videos.overview: Desir and Kraiken are now fighting one-on-one over the magic gem. Can Desir protect Tear of Regernel? And what does Desir hope to achieve by protecting it?

videos.title: Into the Shadow
videos.overview: Desir and the others counterattack Esteban in the Shadow World's Evernatten to correct mistakes in history.

videos.title: Judgment
videos.overview: Having solved the conflict with Esteban, Desir and the others now must solve the refugee crisis.

videos.title: Yellow Ocean
videos.overview: Desir and his party visit Prillecha Kingdom to do special training for the Yellow Ocean Championship.

videos.title: Beginning
videos.overview: While Romantica, Pram, and Azest advance in the championship, a man in a crow mask attacks the castle.

videos.title: Error
videos.overview: Desir and his team confront Batour, Talka, and Sharina, who seem to work under the Crow Mask.

videos.title: Arch Wizard
videos.overview: Dadeinuf appears out of nowhere, and the Crow Mask attacks Desir and the others.

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: Desir faces the Crow Mask, and Zod clashes against Dadeinuf. Then, a bigger threat appears in front of Desir.
